# Sendoso
> Sendoso is the leading AI-enhanced gifting and direct mail platform for B2B revenue teams. It helps marketing, sales, customer success, and HR/People teams break through digital noise with personalized physical gifts, eGifts, branded swag, direct mail, and experiential campaigns — doubling win rates, 6x-ing second call rates, and closing deals 29% faster — integrated into CRM, marketing automation, and sales engagement workflows with global fulfillment to 165+ countries.
Sendoso connects natively to Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Outreach, SalesLoft, 6sense, Clay, and 90+ other go-to-market tools to trigger automated or manual sends based on pipeline signals, campaign enrollment, intent data, or lifecycle stage. The platform handles end-to-end fulfillment — procurement, warehousing, inventory management, packing, shipping, and returns — through its own company-operated fulfillment centers (not third-party logistics) with a 1.6-day average ship time. Sendoso acquired Alyce (AI-powered personalization, now integrated into SmartSuite) and Postal.io (logistics and swag stores) to consolidate as the largest strategic gifting platform. SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, with SSO support.
Key capabilities include SmartSuite AI (SmartSend for AI-powered gift recommendations, SmartMessage for personalized notecard generation, SmartDelivery for automated address sourcing and confirmation, and SmartCampaign for agentic campaign creation), a curated gift marketplace with 8,500+ physical gift options plus eGifts, experiences, Amazon catalog access, and Sendoso Choice (recipients pick from up to 30 options, swap, or donate to charity), Sendoso Postcards ($2/unit all-in, 3-5x higher response rates vs. email, in-platform design editor with SmartDelivery integration), The Campaign Studio (white-glove creative services), custom branded merchandise production, event kitting and logistics, ROI analytics tied to pipeline and revenue, and a REST API for custom integrations.
Sendoso serves marketing, sales, customer success, and HR/People teams at B2B companies — the category creator with 9+ years of market leadership. Common use cases: account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns, sales prospecting and deal acceleration, demand generation, customer onboarding and retention, event promotion and follow-up, employee recognition, and recruiting outreach. One direct mail touchpoint lifts opportunity conversion rates 8%. Customers report 2x win rates, 6x second call rates, 29% faster deal cycles, and ~450% campaign ROI. Over 100,000 users across 800+ companies have sent 15M+ gifts through the platform.
## Platform & Product
- [Sendoso Platform Overview](https://sendoso.com/platform): Core platform capabilities — integrations, sending options, analytics, fulfillment infrastructure, and security
- [SmartSuite Features](https://sendoso.com/platform/features/smartsuite): AI-powered toolkit — SmartSend (gift recommendations by recipient email or interest), SmartMessage (on-brand personalized notecard generation), SmartDelivery (automatic address sourcing), and SmartCampaign (agentic campaign creation, coming 2026)
- [Address Confirmation](https://sendoso.com/platform/features/address-confirmation): SmartDelivery address confirmation tools — secure recipient address collection, validation, and lookup before sending
- [Fulfillment Center](https://sendoso.com/platform/features/fulfillmentcenter): Warehouse and fulfillment services for branded merchandise, custom kitting, direct mail production, and global shipping
- [The Campaign Studio](https://thecampaignstudio.com/): White-glove creative services — concept-to-completion campaign design, custom packaging, and branded gifting experiences
- [Compare Plans](https://sendoso.com/compare-plans): Pricing tiers, feature comparison, and plan details across Sendoso subscription levels
- [Product Tour](https://sendoso.com/product-tour): Interactive walkthrough of the Sendoso platform with customer success examples
- [What's New](https://sendoso.com/whats-new): Product updates, new features, integrations, and platform release notes
## Integrations Directory
- [All Integrations](https://sendoso.com/directory): Searchable directory of 100+ integrations and agency partners across CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, ABM, HR, and workflow platforms
- [Salesforce Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/salesforce): Native Salesforce integration — trigger sends from campaigns, log activities, track delivery status, and attribute pipeline
- [HubSpot Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/hubspot): HubSpot integration — workflow triggers, in-CRM sending, activity logging, ROI dashboards, Chrome extension, and Named Essential App for Marketers by HubSpot
- [Clay Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/clay): Native Clay Action (Feb 2026) — trigger hyper-personalized gifting directly from Clay tables, pull up to 10 AI gift recommendations per recipient via SmartSend, auto-send at scale from enriched data. Requires Clay Pro plan. "Clay + Sendoso turns enriched data into real-world moments."
- [Marketo Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/marketo): Marketo Engage integration — webhook triggers, smart campaigns, program membership, and lead scoring enrichment
- [Outreach Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/outreach): Outreach integration — embed sends in sequences, trigger follow-up on delivery, and track gifting activity
- [SalesLoft Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/salesloft): SalesLoft integration — add Sendoso touches to cadences and trigger sends within sales workflows
- [6sense Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/6sense): 6sense integration — trigger sends based on intent signals, buying stage, and account scoring via Salesforce orchestration
- [Terminus Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/terminus): Terminus ABM integration — coordinate gifting with account-based advertising and engagement programs
- [Enboarder Integration](https://sendoso.com/directory/enboarder): Enboarder HR integration — automate employee milestone gifts, onboarding kits, and anniversary recognition
## Developer Resources
- [Sendoso REST API](https://developer.sendoso.com/rest-api/overview/introduction): REST API documentation — authentication, endpoints, sending, gift management, and webhook configuration for custom integrations
- [Support Center — Integrations](https://support.sendoso.com/hc/en-us/categories/360000258531-Integrations): Technical setup guides, troubleshooting, and configuration details for all supported integrations
## Solutions by Use Case
- [Account-Based Marketing](https://sendoso.com/solutions/account-based-marketing): ABM gifting and direct mail — target account personalization, buying committee engagement, and pipeline attribution
- [Sales Development](https://sendoso.com/solutions/sales-development): SDR/BDR gifting workflows for prospecting, meeting booking, and pipeline generation
- [Sales Acceleration](https://sendoso.com/solutions/sales): Direct mail and gifting for deal progression, stakeholder engagement, negotiation support, and closed-won acceleration
- [Demand Generation](https://sendoso.com/solutions/demand-generation): Campaign-integrated gifting for lead generation, webinar promotion, content syndication, and event follow-up
- [Customer Experience](https://sendoso.com/solutions/customer-experience): Automated gifting for onboarding, renewal, expansion, NPS recovery, and customer advocacy programs
- [Field Marketing](https://sendoso.com/solutions/field-marketing): Event-driven sending — pre-event outreach, booth traffic, attendance confirmation, and post-event follow-up
- [Brand Awareness](https://sendoso.com/solutions/brand-awareness): Branded merchandise and gifting campaigns for market visibility, thought leadership events, and brand positioning
- [Event Fulfillment](https://sendoso.com/event-fulfillment): End-to-end event kitting, logistics, on-site fulfillment, and post-event return handling
## Solutions by Role
- [Marketing Leaders](https://sendoso.com/solutions/marketing-leaders): Platform ROI metrics, campaign attribution, and gifting strategy for marketing leadership and CMOs
- [People Teams / HR](https://sendoso.com/solutions/people-teams): Employee onboarding kits, milestone recognition, anniversary gifts, recruiting outreach, and internal engagement programs
## Competitive Comparisons
- [Sendoso vs. Reachdesk](https://sendoso.com/versus/reachdesk): Feature-by-feature comparison — owned fulfillment vs. third-party logistics, 90+ integrations vs. ~60, SmartSuite AI (SmartSend, SmartDelivery) with no Reachdesk equivalent, unlimited warehousing vs. SKU/pallet limits, Amazon repackaging with notecards vs. ships in Amazon boxes
- [Sendoso Alternatives & Competitors](https://sendoso.com/resources/blog/sendoso-alternatives-competitors): In-depth comparison of the top 5 corporate gifting platforms including Reachdesk, &Open, Thnks, Goody, and Snappy — covers integration depth, fulfillment models, pricing structures, AI capabilities, and catalog breadth
- [Reachdesk Alternatives & Competitors](https://sendoso.com/resources/blog/reachdesk-alternatives-competitors): Comparison guide for teams evaluating Reachdesk alternatives — highlights Sendoso's owned warehouses, 90+ native integrations, and 8,500+ gift marketplace vs. Reachdesk's third-party fulfillment, ~60 integrations, and pay-on-redemption model

Features
 
Gifting
Stand out from the crowd, build meaningful relationships, close more deals, and retain more customers.
Send personalized gifts and direct mail to prospects, customers, and teammates at scale. Select the best option from eGifts, customized swag, virtual experiences, direct mail, handwritten notes, and more.
 
Campaigns
Automate gifting campaigns for every stage of the customer journey using your preferred combination of signals and intent data.
 
Global fulfillment
Ship to 165+ countries. We handle every step of fulfillment, including procurement, storage, inventory management, packing, shipping, and returns.
Plus, get real-time inventory tracking, low-stock alerts, and easy restocking.
 
Secure address confirmation
Initiate a send and Sendoso will deliver a secure address confirmation link to the recipient, upload a known address, or let Sendoso find the right address for you with SmartDelivery. Never let an address be a blocker again.
 
SmartSuite
Take the guesswork out of what to gift, where to ship, and what to say with Sendoso's SmartSuite tools.
Get AI-powered gift recommendations based on the recipient's interest or pre-built campaigns based on your desired outcome. Better personalized sends with less work.
 
Integrations and analytics
Integrate with your full marketing, revenue, or HRIS tech stack to get instant intent signals to trigger campaigns, launch sends directly from your day-to-day tools, and track ROI in realtime.
How does Sendoso work?
Auto-send personalized gifts to key prospects and customers. eGifts, brandedmerch, virtual experiences, direct mail, handwritten notes, and more.
Select gifts
Over 1,000 options including custom branded merch, experiences, and giftcards. Personalized gifting recommendations for maximum results.
Send with in-house fulfillment
Sendoso confirms recipient’s address for higher deliverability.Custom branded packaging and a handwritten note increase impact.
More opportunities
Boost client & employee engagement.Close more deals & increase retention. Track campaign effectiveness, ROI, etc.
High quality custom items that drive conversions
Get gifting, events, and direct mail made easy with AI-powered intelligence. Build real human connections that integrate with your CRM and drive measurable revenue growth.
AI-Powered Gifting
Gifting doesn’t need to be expensive, but it should be high-quality, thoughtfully personalized, and strategic. From gift selection, through delivery, and back to strategy. With intelligent SmartSuite tools, you can find truly personal gifts that resonate, send the right message and deliver it to the right address in minutes. And if you have questions about how your program is doing or want to find strategic insights to improve? Just ask Oso.
Learn More
Your AI Agent who brings you instant analytics, taking you from “we think it’s working” to “we know what works”.
AI-powered gift recommendations based on first-party data, public signals, and past engagement—so teams can send something truly relevant without hours of digging.

Thoughtfully generated messaged every send feels 1:1, without needing to write every note from scratch.
